name: Awao Tsukasa
source:
Sex: Female
Occupation: High School Student; Apprentice Ama Diver
Age: 17 years old

A girl born and raised in Kameshima. She has a bright, friendly nature and an inquisitive personality. Currently in her second year of high school, she boasts excellent grades and a sharp intuition.
* * *
She has been staying at a relative's house in Ise City since last year in order to attend an all-girl's high school on the mainland, and is currently back on Kameshima for summer break. Despite this, she frequently makes trips back to the island on weekends, and has been trying her hand at underwater gathering since the current diving season began, having long been interested in the ama lifestyle. Her estimated Diver Rank is 6. However, her teachers have been strongly encouraging her to aim for a national university.
She has been friends with [url=/c163941]Azami Kumoi[/url] and [url=/c163937]Yuza Minakuchi[/url] since childhood, with their close rapport making up for their difference in academic years, and it was more common to find her playing with the two boys than with girls her own age up until middle school. However, since leaving the island to attend high school, she has grown more conscious of their age difference, and has put some distance between herself and them.
She hit it off immediately with [url=/c163938]Sato Shiranami[/url], a girl who came to Kameshima to lodge with the [url=/c164208]Wakamuras[/url] a few months ago, and was looking forward to showing her around the island and helping her adapt to life there whenever she returns home.
* * *
18 years ago, her still pregnant mother, [url=/c165563]Nagisa Awao[/url], moved to Kameshima alone before giving birth to Tsukasa shortly afterwards. Tsukasa subsequently grew up in a single-mother household. Although she used to occasionally ask her mother about her father, her questions were always evaded, so she has since stopped inquiring. However, the fact that her mother never seems to have any financial difficulty despite not working has led her to quietly suspect he might still be involved in some way.
[spoiler]* * *
In truth, Tsukasa secretly tracked down her father —[url=/c164716]a wealthy man who owns multiple companies in Ise[/url]— and knows that she is his illegitimate child. She has apparently even gone out to dinner with him several times, but keeps this a secret from her mother.[/spoiler]

[From in-game profile]
